builder_notes.pattern: Unsupported-format bug revealed by test: original page called captureSnapshot before checking file extension
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: When extracting a multi-branch handler, trace each branch's side-effects independently; the guard belongs before the side-effect, not after
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Mutation (snapshot/dispatch) only runs when the guard passes — never before the if.
builder_notes.stack_example: useImportHandlers.ts:31-40: captureSnapshot now inside each if/else if branch, not before the conditional.

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Look for useCallback blocks with identical dependency arrays listing 4+ state values
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: When 3+ callbacks share the same 4+ deps, they belong in one hook.
builder_notes.stack_example: handleExportJSON, handleExportCSV, handleExportMarkdown all have [projectName, tierOrder, tierLabels, tierColors, tiers] as deps.

builder_notes.pattern: Test-at-new-Interface: FileReader async callback tested synchronously via jest.spyOn
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Any hook whose side-effect flows through a DOM/platform callback requires a synchronous test double
builder_notes.stack_example: useImportHandlers.test.ts mockFileReaderWith() spies on globalThis.FileReader and calls onload synchronously.
